causally_supported_fixture_defect.mechanism: Patching module.time.monotonic mutates the shared Python time module. An unrelated real reader consumes the first value of the finite side_effect list; the target expires before entering verifier admission.
causally_supported_fixture_defect.deterministic_schedule: Start an unrelated waiting thread before fixture patch. Release and join its single monotonic read immediately after the original patch enters, before original dispatch. No sleep, altered deadline or retry.
causally_supported_fixture_defect.minimal_fix: Patch only wallet_backend.contract_runtime.time with a wrapping proxy, then set proxy.monotonic.side_effect. No runtime file change.
causally_supported_fixture_defect.historical_attribution: NOT ESTABLISHED. Original clock fixture passed at zero-based ordinal39; TLS failure occurred at157, with117 intervening cases. The clock patch was no longer active.

thread_lifecycle_observation.conclusion: No persistent thread leak or retained global monkeypatch observed across these70 related cases. Does not prove absence under original runner scheduling.

exact_missing_observation: At original1s client failure, server worker stack and current request stage: TLS handshake/header/body parsing, owner admission, SQLite wait/commit, signature verification, or response send.
Per-request elapsed time and server thread/process CPU counters together with runnable/waiting thread state to distinguish CPU scheduling/GIL pressure from I/O/lock waiting.
Original runner CPU throttling/run-queue or I/O wait observation if server request timing shows unexplained scheduling or disk delay.
closure_requirements: Attribute historical cause only with supporting original simultaneous observations or a faithful documented environmental reproduction explaining the original trace. Fresh passes and synthetic injection alone are insufficient.
available_next_evidence: Already integrated failure-time all-thread/resource capture and hashed sidecars can capture server state on recurrence without modifying deadlines/outcomes. Successful final CI sidecars are empty and cannot recover past state.
